content: Date picker: @react-native-community/datetimepicker 9.1.0 is bundled in Expo Go SDK 57 (expo docs inExpoGo:true); use maximumDate={today} to block future dates. @expo/ui offers a native SwiftUI/Compose drop-in replacement but is new. Keyboard: react-native-keyboard-controller 1.21.9 is bundled in Expo Go SDK 57 (Expo docs page exists, inExpoGo:true); KeyboardAwareScrollView is the modern recommended keyboard-aware component; core KeyboardAvoidingView remains the zero-dependency fallback.
